findings.skill_statement: "No row here changes rank, SHONEN authority, the six recorded cases, ..." names the lane's measured-case set as six at C*, but the same SKILL.md records a seventh case ("## Seventh recorded case and full-page cold-read — round 16"), an eighth (round 18) and a ninth (round 26), and its runner row states the registry is "ten since round 51"; the case set the sentence names no longer exists, so a cold reader takes a stale set size as current.

findings.skill_statement: "... and no successor sweep or seventh case is claimed." is a present-tense negation that fails at C*: the seventh recorded case is claimed outright in SKILL.md ("## Seventh recorded case and full-page cold-read — round 16", "**The seventh case.** kumitate `scripts/round-gate.mjs` at rev `364f1d5` ..."), followed by the eighth (round 18) and ninth (round 26) cases, so the sentence holds only at its round-15 write and is contradicted by the file it sits in.
